_doc: High-value competitive singleton / utility moves the tutor should surface as SUITABLE even when Smogon usage data for the species is thin or absent. Each entry: class (drives a heuristic score FLOOR for Status moves that would otherwise read as filler=30, and the grid badge) + note (a short player-facing reason shown on the card). The floor NEVER lowers an already-higher score (recovery/setup keep their existing weights); it only rescues elite utility that the old status table scored 30. Damaging moves (U-turn, Knock Off, Rapid Spin…) already score on power — they are listed only for the badge/note. Classes + floors are maintainer-owned; tune freely. Foe rolls are unaffected (this feeds the player-facing tutor scorer only).

U-turn.note: Pivot: deal damage, then switch to a better matchup.

Volt Switch.note: Pivot: chip the foe, then switch out for free.

Flip Turn.note: Pivot: hit hard, then bring in a teammate safely.

Parting Shot.note: Pivot + debuff: drop the foe's Atk & SpA, then switch out.

Teleport.note: Slow pivot: switch out and bring a partner in safely.

Baton Pass.note: Pass your stat boosts to a teammate on the switch.

Shed Tail.note: Pass a Substitute to a teammate for a free setup.

Chilly Reception.note: Set snow and pivot out in one move.

Tailwind.note: Doubles your team's Speed for a few turns.

Trick Room.note: Slow Pokemon move first for 5 turns.

Sticky Web.note: Lowers the Speed of foes that switch in.

Thunder Wave.note: Paralyze: cut the foe's Speed and risk full paralysis.

Will-O-Wisp.note: Burn: halves the foe's physical damage + chip each turn.

Toxic.note: Badly poison: ramping damage that wins long fights.

Spore.note: Guaranteed sleep — the best disabling status.

Sleep Powder.note: Sleep the foe to take it out of the fight.

Stealth Rock.note: Chip every foe that switches in — best entry hazard.

Spikes.note: Stacking ground chip on grounded switch-ins.

Toxic Spikes.note: Poisons grounded foes as they switch in.

Defog.note: Clears hazards from your side (and screens).

Rapid Spin.note: Removes hazards and boosts your Speed.

Court Change.note: Swaps your hazards onto the foe's side.

Mortal Spin.note: Removes hazards, poisons foes, and hits.

Knock Off.note: Strong hit that removes the foe's held item.

Trick.note: Forces a Choice/Assault item onto the foe, locking it.

Switcheroo.note: Swaps items — dump a bad item onto the foe.

Encore.note: Locks the foe into its last move — free setup window.

Taunt.note: Blocks status/setup — shuts down walls and leads.

Haze.note: Wipes all stat changes — stops a sweeper cold.

Whirlwind.note: Forces the foe out, racking up hazard chip.

Roar.note: Phazes the foe out into hazards.

Dragon Tail.note: Damage + forces the foe out into hazards.

Heal Bell.note: Cures your whole team's status conditions.

Aromatherapy.note: Cures your whole team's status conditions.

Wish.note: Delayed heal you can pass to a teammate.

Healing Wish.note: Faints to fully heal + cure the next Pokemon in.

Lunar Dance.note: Faints to fully restore the next Pokemon in.

Revival Blessing.note: Revives a fainted teammate at half HP.

Memento.note: Faints while crashing the foe's Atk & SpA — free setup.

Reflect.note: Halves physical damage to your team for 5 turns.

Light Screen.note: Halves special damage to your team for 5 turns.

Aurora Veil.note: Halves both physical and special damage in snow.

Substitute.note: Blocks a hit and status — sets up safely.

Protect.note: Blocks a turn — scout, stall, or trigger an item.
